notes.title: Summer Update
notes.notes:
This update adds an Annotation system into the game which includes...

1.) Notes - Users can now create notes that are linked to specific verses and translations of The Bible. 

2.) Custom Notes - Users can also create custom notes not linked to any particular passage or translation, from the Annotations menu. 

3.) Verse Highlighting - Users can now click on any verse in order to highlight it, verse highlights are specific to the translation being read at the time. 

4.) Annotations Menu - Users now have a place where all notes and highlights will be stored and organized. With the ability to filter by translation. 

5.) The game's Main Menu has been overhauled to provide a more aesthetically appropriate and pleasing experience for players. 




MISC.

Other small tweaks were made to the system, adding the ability to navigate within notes via the arrow keys and the use of the enter button, to make editing and altering notes easier. 

Ability to navigate annotations menus and scrollbars using the mousewheel and arrow keys. 

Adding sound effects for the various new buttons in annotations and the main menu.

notes.title: The Bible version 1.1 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Bible Search – Added feature where users can look for any word or phrase. All instances of that word or phrase in all translations will be displayed in a list. When the user selects one of the search results that word or phrase will appear highlighted everywhere it appears in a given chapter of the Bible. 

King James Version Bible has been added

American Standard Version Bible has been added

Young’s Literal Translation Bible has been added

Darby Translation Bible has been added

Reina-Valera Antigua Bible has been added

RMB – Flips back a page

Audiobook no longer plays when pausing the game and navigating through other menus.

Added Title Screen button to bottom of screen while reading to make navigation through the game easier.

Improved functionality of ‘Back’ button at bottom of screen, and it now indicates where exactly the user will be taken back to when it is clicked. 

World English Bible Translation was removed and re-implemented with improved formatting. 

Verse numbers are now highlighted and underlined in all translations to improve readability.

Added notation in the upper margin when reading which indicates what book and chapter the user is in at all times.

notes.title: Patch 1.001
notes.notes:
Bug Fix - Game would crash when players tried to open chapters 2, 3, 4, or 5 of the book 1 John. This has been fixed. 

Bug Fix - Game would crash when players tried to open chapter 24 of the book of Joshua. This has been fixed. 

If you encounter any bugs, or have requests for new features, or improvements to existing features e-mail us at biblegamescommunity@outlook.com

We will have another patch out in a few days to address a few issues.
